chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who creates a statue will be commanded on the Day of Resurrection to blow the spirit into it.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the creator of a statue on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the concept of *tashbih* (resembling God) through the act of creating lifeless forms, a key theme in Shia jurisprudence regarding *taswir* (image-making). It serves as a spiritual warning that the creator of the image will be tested on the Day of Judgment to breathe life into it, a feat they will fail due to their limited power, thus emphasizing the uniqueness of Divine Creation.
